events.text: The soul-iron cools, and clone {cf_slot} stands up out of the forge already looking for someone to fight. "{cf_clone}," it says, trying the name. "Good. A name the teahouses will learn." It looks at you as if you were the first opponent.

choices.text: "Then make them learn it. I will be proud of you."

effects.log: It grins your grin, wider than you ever wear it, and goes to find the biggest mountain.

choices.text: "Win where you can. Come home where you cannot."

effects.log: It shrugs, as if coming home were for other people, and goes.

choices.text: "You are my blade. A blade does not choose its fights."

effects.log: Its jaw sets. It goes, and you feel it choose its own fights the moment it is out of sight.

events.text: Clone {cf_slot} opens its eyes slowly, the way you open a door in a house at night. "{cf_clone}," it says, as if checking the name for traps. "Where are you sending me, and how many ways are there back?"

choices.text: "As many as you need. Come home whenever you like."

effects.log: It lets out a breath you did not know a clone could hold, and smiles.

choices.text: "Three roads, and you will learn a fourth."

effects.log: It nods, and you see it already counting the roads.

choices.text: "One road. Mine. Walk it."

effects.log: It walks it. It does not look back, and it does not look happy.

events.text: Clone {cf_slot} stands up, straightens a robe that is not yet creased, and asks the first question of its life: "Who in this world needs help, and why has nobody helped them?" It names itself {cf_clone} before you can.

choices.text: "Everyone, a little. Go and be the help I cannot be everywhere."

effects.log: It bows to you, and there is nothing of a servant in the bow.

choices.text: "Help where it pays to help. We are not a temple."

effects.log: It frowns, and goes, and you suspect it will help where it does not pay.

choices.text: "Your conscience is borrowed from me. Do not spend it."

effects.log: It looks at you for a long moment, the way the righteous look at the powerful.

events.text: Clone {cf_slot} does not stand up at once. It lies on the warm stone and smiles at the ceiling, and when it speaks you hear a thought of yours you have never said aloud. "{cf_clone}," it says. "I think we are going to be rich."

choices.text: "We are. Bring me the world, and I will share it with you."

effects.log: It laughs, delighted, and for a moment the laugh is almost fond.

choices.text: "Rich, and careful. I will be watching the books."

effects.log: "Of course you will," it says. "So will I."

choices.text: "You are a purse with legs. Fill yourself and come home."

effects.log: Something behind its eyes writes your words down, to read again later.

events.text: The thread jerks in your chest. Clone {cf_slot}, {cf_clone}, is cornered in a ravine by five divine beasts, each older than a dynasty, and the eldest has its paw on the clone's chest.

choices.text: Descend into it and fight with your true power

effects.log: You let go of your own body and fall down the thread. The eldest beast feels who is looking out of the clone's eyes, and is afraid.

choices.text: Speak through the thread and guide its hands

effects.log: You tell it where the old beast is lame, and which of the five is only the eldest's shadow.

choices.text: Let it fend for itself

effects.log: You close the thread and go back to your tea. Your hand shakes, a little, as you lift the cup.
